preview.text: Kenya won the toss and chose to bowl first against Qatar in the one-day match at Ruaraka Sports Club Ground, where the usual first-innings score in the 8 recorded one-day matches is 227. The forecast for the next 8 hours indicates about 28 degrees and up to a 59 per cent chance of rain.

summary.text: Qatar won by 4 runs. QAT made 283-10, Zubair Ali top-scoring with 92 off 102 balls; Rakep Patel took 3 for 48. KEN made 279-10, Irfan Karim (wk) top-scoring with 86 off 105 balls; Owais Ahmed took 4 for 33. Sides batting first at Ruaraka Sports Club Ground usually make about 227.
